description: This source file contains extension methods and utility functions for the Date object, part of the DateJS library, providing additional date manipulation and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time of the Date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing the current date with time cleared.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two dates, returning -1, 0, or 1 based on their order.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a specific year.
